line_or_section: Outcome table and Error rates (rows 1 and 2)
finding: The headline 0 of 509 staged value fields in disagreement (0.0 percent) hides 31 staged value fields that neither reader confirmed: the staged stack_bytes of S13-001 to S13-021 (pqm4 e1146b1) and the staged flash_or_code_bytes of S13-136 to S13-145 (TCHES 11671). Both readers put the pqm4 memory number in ram_bytes (42 reader_extra readings) and both left the 11671 code size blank (no unit printed). The script counts these as not_at_location, not as disagreements, and the doc describes the status as 'only one reader confirmed a value', which is false (zero readers confirmed). The 1150 not_at_location readings are described as fields 'stated away from the cited location', which does not fit a field a reader placed in another column.
evidence: summary.csv: stack_bytes not_at_location 42, ram_bytes reader_extra 42 (rows S13-001..021); S13-136 flash 32520 not_at_location for reader1 and reader2 with note 'table gives no unit'. Staged value fields not confirmed by both readers: 31 of 509 (6.1 percent).
suggested_fix: Count a staged value that a reader puts in another field, or that no reader confirms, as a disagreement or as a separate 'not confirmed' line in the rate table (31 of 509); reword the single reader status so it covers 'no reader confirmed'; fix the not_at_location sentence.

finding: The wording synonyms (keygen for Key Generation, Keypair, key pair generation and so on) are new in round 5 and, by the script's own comment, were 'fixed before the third look answers were read', that is after the reader comparison had produced the list of wording disagreements. evidence: Script comment: 'Wording synonyms, fixed before the third look answers were read'; docstring: rules 'imported unchanged' with one change about routing only. No mention of SYNONYMS in docs/VERIFICATION6.md.
suggested_fix: State in VERIFICATION6.md that the synonym list was added after the first comparison was seen and give the wording rate with and without it.

finding: Line 5 says the comparison rules 'were fixed before the comparison ran'. Line 32 reports the round 5 third look (153 of 365, 7 of 425) without saying that match rules R1 to R5 were written after a first literal comparison and that the substance decisions in third_look_manual.csv were made with all values in view (not blind). line_or_section: section 4 last table row; VERIFICATION5 line 32; contradiction()
finding: The pooled 'staging wrong in substance' rate 7 of 425 (1.6 percent) adds the round 4 sample count (6 of 60, judged as 'staging was wrong' under the round 4 rule) to a round 5 count judged with a different and lenient substance test. The automatic test only flags a scheme at family level, a parameter set only when no number is shared, and returns 'no contradiction' when an operation cannot be mapped (for example staged 'permutation (one call)' against source 'Keccak', S12A-091 to S12A-099). The 0 of 264 for judged fields is therefore partly by construction.
evidence: contradiction(): scheme compares _family(); parameter_set 'disjoint' only; operation returns '' unless both canon_op values exist. third_look_classified.csv S12A-091 operation: 'wording only, no contradiction found'.
suggested_fix: Report the two rates separately, describe the leniency of each automatic test, and classify unmappable lines as 'not judged' instead of 'no contradiction found'.

finding: Row promoted as 'ECDSA P-256 (classical baseline)'. The source names only 'ECC256 + SHA256' and 'ECC256 over SHA256 (classical signatures)'; it names neither ECDSA nor a curve. The third reader returned scheme 'ECC256' and marked parameter_set ambiguous_source, yet the row is promoted (VERIFICATION6 table defines blocked as including 'the source is ambiguous' and reports 0 blocked). Only value fields can block, which the doc does not say.
evidence: Web fetch of the wolfSSL page (2026-10-21): 'ECC256 + SHA256' column; article does not say ECDSA or name a curve. data/verify6/third_look.csv S13-147 scheme ECC256 found; parameter_set ambiguous_source.
suggested_fix: Set scheme to the source wording (ECC256, algorithm and curve not stated) or cite a source for ECDSA P-256; state in VERIFICATION6.md that an ambiguous wording field does not block promotion.

finding: The four ePrint 2026/1915 values were read by both readers and the third reader only through a summarising fetch tool ('table reproduced on request') after curl was refused. Protocol inclusion 4 forbids values from 'a summary alone' and exclusion 4 says refusals are 'not worked around'; D05 records the curl refusal and the switch to the fetch tool. The three readings share one tool, so they are not independent. I reproduced the same values through the same tool (curl to eprint.iacr.org returned HTTP 403 on 2026-10-21, refusal recorded), which does not settle the point.
evidence: reader_flags.csv: 'both readers could read the source only through a summarising web fetch tool'; S13_search_log D05: 'refused for curl (browser challenge page); ePrint pages read with web fetch instead'.
suggested_fix: Mark these rows as read through a summarising tool in a dedicated column or keep them out of the verified set until the PDF is read directly (author download), and state the deviation from inclusion 4 and exclusion 4.
